subject: Re: Time-box addendum and concession options for VireoAI pilot
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vireoai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot runway options and packaging — VireoAI POC

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the ingestion speed and retrieval latency you validated. Per your ask, attaching a short worksheet that lays out two concrete paths to keep the pilot moving while we work through procurement:

1) Short extension + conversion incentive (recommended):
   - 21-day time-box extension at no additional charge
   - If Vireo signs a 6-month Dedicated commit within 30 days of extension end, Redwood will apply a 15% first-quarter credit (applied as invoice credit)

2) Credit bucket alternative:
   - 120k token credit pool (usable during pilot) in lieu of a pure time extension
   - Higher burst protection but no extension of the calendar end date

I attached the POC-Terms-worksheet.xlsx with estimated economics and the pilot-runway-playbook.pdf that explains milestone validation checkpoints we typically use. We can be flexible on the exact burst profile (weekday-only heavy load vs full-week).

Next steps: can you confirm which path procurement would prefer? If you want, we can set a 30-minute call with Marissa (commercial) and Neha (finance) tomorrow to align on what makes legal/procurement comfortable.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vireoai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asha Verma <asha@vireoai.com>
Date: 2027-10-26T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway options and packaging — VireoAI POC

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear options. Quick answers from procurement:
- They prefer an extension over credits because our board wants more calendar runway for verification.
- Legal will likely push back on the 15% being conditioned on a 6-month commit — they'd rather see a smaller unconditional extension plus a one-time pilot discount.

Can your team do: 30-day extension + 10% unconditional pilot discount (applies to any paid engagement signed within 60 days)? Also we have a PO process that needs a simple addendum rather than a full SOW redline.

If you can send a redline-friendly one-pager and the worksheet updated with the 30-day delta, we'll take to procurement tomorrow.

— Liam
Director of Product
VireoAI
liam.oconnor@vireoai.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vireoai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-26T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway options and packaging — VireoAI POC

Liam — thanks for the clear guidance.

Happy to accommodate a 30-day extension. Two clarifying notes on the concession:

- We can offer a 30-day calendar extension immediately (no charge).
- For the pilot discount, we can make a one-time 10% commercial credit that applies to the first invoice of any paid engagement signed within 60 days. This removes the 6-month commit condition and should help legal/procurement.

I'll loop in Marissa to prepare an addendum that contains simple language procurement can attach to the PO. Marissa — can you draft a redline-friendly one-pager and attach a clean PDF (no markup) + a redlineed version for legal? Neha — please confirm finance is comfortable applying a one-time credit to invoice.

I'll send a follow-up once we have the addendum.

Best,
Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-10-27T09:44:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft addendum for VireoAI — first pass

On Wed, Oct 27, 2027 at 09:44 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Attaching a draft one-pager and an annotated redline. The language is intentionally short to match PO attachment expectations.

Marissa here — see attached redline-draft.pdf and a clean addendum in the shared Drive link below. Key commercial items included: 30-day extension, 10% one-time pilot credit (applies to first paid invoice within 60 days), and a clause for weekday-burst protection (we'll honor up to 2x baseline token throughput Mon-Fri).

Neha — finance note: this credit will be booked as a contra-revenue item and applied at invoicing. Any concerns we should call out in the addendum?

Attachments: redline-draft.pdf
Shared link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1vireo-addendum

— Marissa
Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vireoai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T16:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot runway options and packaging — VireoAI POC

Liam / Asha —

Thanks for the quick turn. Attached is the clean addendum and the redline for legal (redline-draft.pdf). Summary of what we're proposing — final: 

- 30-day calendar extension to the existing pilot (no cost)
- One-time 10% commercial credit applied to the first paid invoice for any paid engagement signed within 60 days of the extension end
- Weekday burst protection: Redwood will provide up to 2x baseline token throughput Mon-Fri during the extended period (daytime hours).

If that matches procurement's ask, reply with a thumbs-up and we'll provide the final PDF for PO attachment (DocuSign only if you need signatures). To be transparent, this concession is a one-time commercial accommodation tied to the current pilot and not a precedent for other deals.

Related: HubSpot deal is updated (HB-4827-vireo) and I've added the addendum to the record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4827.

Next step options:
- Procurement approval + PO attachment = we start the 30-day extension the day the signed PO is attached to the HubSpot record.
- If you'd prefer DocuSign, ping and we'll route that link.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

---
Attachments: pilot-runway-playbook.pdf, redline-draft.pdf, POC-Terms-worksheet.xlsx
